facts.text: I want to become a specialized pharmacist in oncology or geriatrics.
I am asking how long it takes to complete both the PGY1 and PGY2 residency programs for oncology or geriatrics.
I am asking whether there are any other requirements besides completing the residencies and obtaining certification from the Board of Pharmacy Specialties.
I want to know if I can skip the residency programs and just obtain certification from the Board of Pharmacy Specialties.
I think the residency programs take a lot of time and effort.
I am looking for shortcuts or easier ways to become a specialized pharmacist in oncology or geriatrics.
I do not want to waste so much time and effort.
I do not understand why becoming a specialized pharmacist has to be complicated.
I want to learn on the job and gain experience that way.
I am asking what the point is of the extra requirements.
I think the requirements are excessive.
I am asking how much of the specialized training and knowledge is actually used on a daily basis.
I think specialized training and knowledge requirements waste a lot of time and money.
I think certification programs and residency programs are trying to make more money off aspiring pharmacists.
I do not think the extra training is necessary.
I think the extra training is a burden for people who want to specialize in these areas.
I think these programs are trying to make it harder for aspiring pharmacists to succeed.
